impressum.title: Legal notice (Impressum)
impressum.operatorBody: Agent Platform — platform for AI-assisted capture and qualification of website inquiries for businesses.
impressum.contactBody: For contractual, technical, and legal inquiries, please contact the platform operator using the contact details provided during registration or in your contract.
impressum.disputeBody: The European Commission provides an online dispute resolution platform: https://ec.europa.eu/consumers/odr/. We are neither obliged nor willing to participate in dispute resolution proceedings before a consumer arbitration board.

datenschutz.title: Privacy policy
datenschutz.intro: Protecting your personal data matters to us. Below we explain how we process personal data when you use this platform.
datenschutz.controllerBody: The data controller under the GDPR is the operator of the Agent Platform. Please refer to the legal notice (Impressum) for contact details.
datenschutz.dataCollectedBody: We process data you provide when registering and using the dashboard (e.g. name, email, company details). Chat messages and lead details captured via the website widget (e.g. name, phone, location, service request) are stored to handle customer inquiries.
datenschutz.purposeBody: Processing is carried out to provide the platform, capture and qualify leads, notify your team by email, and manage your tenant account.
datenschutz.legalBasisBody: Processing is based on Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR (contract performance) and Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR (legitimate interest in secure and reliable operation), unless you have given separate consent.
datenschutz.hostingBody: The platform is operated on servers in the European Union. Data is transmitted over HTTPS.
datenschutz.processorsBody: We use carefully selected processors to deliver the service, e.g. for email delivery (Resend) and AI-assisted conversation processing (OpenAI). Required data processing agreements are in place. We do not use your customer data to train our own or third-party AI models.
datenschutz.retentionBody: Personal data is stored only as long as necessary for the purposes stated or as required by law.
datenschutz.rightsBody: You have the right to access, rectify, erase, restrict processing, data portability, and object. You may lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority.
datenschutz.securityBody: We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your data, including encrypted connections (HTTPS) and access controls.
datenschutz.changesBody: We may update this privacy policy when legal requirements or our services change. The current version is always available on this page.

settings.pageDescription: Manage company profile, email notifications, and chat on your website.
settings.savedSlugChanged: Settings saved. The chat reference changed — copy the embed code to your website again.
settings.companyProfileHint: You can update name, email, and phone here anytime — not only during sign-up.
settings.name: Name
settings.slugHint: Derived from your company name and used in the chat embed code. It updates when the name changes.
settings.serviceAreaHint: The chat checks inquiries by postal code. Enter your location with PLZ (e.g. 22303 Hamburg).
settings.emailDeliveryHint: Inquiry notifications and password reset use the same server configuration (Resend).
settings.emailDeliveryProviderLogging: Mode: development (no real emails — password reset shows a local link).
settings.emailDeliveryProviderResendIncomplete: Resend is selected but API key or sender is missing in the server .env.
settings.emailDeliveryResendSetup: Server .env: NOTIFICATION_PROVIDER=resend, RESEND_API_KEY, NOTIFICATION_FROM_EMAIL (verified domain), FRONTEND_BASE_URL. Then restart the backend.
settings.notificationEmailPlaceholder: Leave empty to use company email
settings.notificationEmailFallbackHint: Without a dedicated address, notifications use your company email above. Test emails work the same way.
settings.notifyContactable: Notify on reachable inquiries above priority threshold
settings.contactableThresholdHint: Priority is a score from 0 to 100. It rises as more details are captured. For reachable inquiries, we notify from this threshold upward.
settings.testNotificationSaveFirst: Please save the email address first.
settings.testNotificationSuccess: We sent a test email to {email}.
settings.testNotificationMissingEmail: Please save an email address first.
settings.testNotificationFailed: Could not send the test email.
settings.widgetDescription: Copy the embed code and add it to your website. The status below shows whether chat is already active there. Optionally add a privacy policy link in the code for visitors.
settings.copyFailed: Unable to copy. Select the code manually.

activation.embedMissingInstallKey: The embed code is incomplete. Please reload the page or contact support.
activation.staleGuidance: Open your website once in your browser.
activation.installHtmlBody: Paste the embed code at the end of every page where chat should appear — just before the page closes.

activation.installAgencyBody: Send the embed code to your web agency and ask them to add it to your website — ideally on all pages before the page closes.
